author: josh
description: A single-server Modmail ticket system featuring HTML transcripts, anonymous logging badges, department routing, and role-immunity defenses.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores user IDs and channel IDs in the bot's local configuration to map active support tickets. When a ticket is closed, its channel configuration metadata is wiped out. HTML transcripts are archived to a configured Discord channel and are not saved locally on the host machine.
install_msg: Modmail loaded successfully. Make sure to set your log channel using `[prefix]modmailset logchannel` and map your categories using `[prefix]modmailset department set` before opening tickets. Sync slash commands using `[prefix]tree sync`.
name: Modmail
short: Advanced single-server Modmail support ticket system.
